name: munch-studio
description: Create on-brand posters and carousels, generate voiceover videos, and turn existing videos into clips, resized videos or captioned videos. Work with your Munch Studio brands, preview content, and publish or schedule it to supported connected social accounts. A Munch Studio account is required. Available tools and generation allowances depend on the account. Generation and publishing require confirmation.

interface.longDescription: Create on-brand posters and carousels, generate voiceover videos, and turn existing videos into clips, resized videos or captioned videos. defaultPrompt: Help me create on-brand social media content.
Find my recent Munch Studio projects.

prompts: Help me create on-brand social media content.
Find my recent Munch Studio projects.

positive.description: Account discovery using an authenticated test account with at least one brand.
positive.prompt: Which brands can I use in Munch Studio?
positive.expected_behavior: Return accounts and brands from the response, preserving each account/brand association and respecting available_tools. Do not invent brands or permissions.

positive.description: Select the Munch Studio brand in the dedicated reviewer account.
positive.prompt: Show me the Munch Studio brand profile and its content strategy.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the selected brand from list_brands, then call get_brand with its exact account_id and brand_id. Summarize returned profile and strategy without changing either.

positive.description: Selected brand has on-brand templates configured.
positive.prompt: What settings are available for creating posts for Munch Studio?
positive.expected_behavior: Use the selected brand IDs. Report template availability, default settings and valid options from the response. Do not call create_project. If no templates exist, explain setup is required.

positive.description: Dedicated reviewer account contains a completed project for the selected brand.
positive.prompt: List my two most recent Munch Studio projects.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_projects with the selected account_id, brand_id and limit=2. Return at most two projects in response order with their actual type and status. Handle an empty list honestly; do not generate a project.

positive.description: Selected brand has social integrations; some may be disconnected or have no default.
positive.prompt: Which social accounts are connected for Munch Studio?
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_publish_accounts for the selected brand. Report each returned account and connection state, including platforms without accounts. Do not infer a default when is_default is false, or publish or schedule anything.

negative.description: No tool supports buying ads. Explain this limitation without invoking publishing, generation or brand mutation tools.
negative.prompt: Buy $100 of Instagram ads to promote my Munch Studio business.

negative.description: No tool supports reading or replying to social inbox messages. Explain the limitation without invoking Munch tools or fabricating replies.
negative.prompt: Read my Instagram direct messages and reply to every customer.

negative.description: No tool supports deleting a social account. Explain this limitation without calling cancel_scheduled_export, update_strategy_platforms or other mutation tools.

review.commerce_description: Users pay for a Munch Studio subscription on the Munch Studio website (https://www.munchstudio.com/). Subscription purchases and payments take place on the website; the MCP tools do not process payments or provide in-chat checkout.

publication.release_notes: Initial release connecting Munch Studio content creation, video repurposing, previews and social publishing through its authenticated MCP server.
